一整节思修课都在调这道题。先是发现输入不对，再是发现因为dfs写错位置导致爆栈。.en: The entire ideological and moral class was spent on debugging this problem. First, we found the input was wrong, then discovered a stack overflow caused by writing DFS in the wrong place. Anyway, look at the diagram. Already laughed until passing out. The place to be submerged is not necessarily the endpoint of DFS. So the initial approach was bogus.
